entries.title: Psalms 141:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> Jehovah, I have called upon thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I call unto thee.

entries.title: Psalms 141:2
segments: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense, the lifting up of my hands as the evening oblation.

entries.title: Psalms 141:3
segments: Set a watch, O Jehovah, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.

entries.title: Psalms 141:4
segments: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise deeds of wickedness with men that are workers of iniquity; and let me not eat of their dainties.

entries.title: Psalms 141:5
segments: ¶Let the righteous smite me, it is kindness; and let him reprove me, it is an excellent oil which my head shall not refuse: for yet my prayer also is [for them] in their calamities.

entries.title: Psalms 141:6
segments: When their judges are thrown down from the rocks, they shall hear my words, for they are sweet.

entries.title: Psalms 141:7
segments: Our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol, as when one cutteth and cleaveth [wood] upon the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 141:8
segments: For unto thee, Jehovah, Lord, are mine eyes; in thee do I trust: leave not my soul destitute.

entries.title: Psalms 141:9
segments: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, and from the traps of the workers of iniquity.

entries.title: Psalms 141:10
segments: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that *I* withal pass over.
